01We are an authorised dealer for ROTO Group and ASIO, which rank among Europe's market leaders in…

We are an authorised dealer for ROTO Group and ASIO, which rank among Europe's market leaders in rainwater management.

ROTO Group is regarded as one of the world's largest manufacturers of plastic products. Its rainwater range covers a broad portfolio of high-quality products, above all self-supporting underground storage tanks for rainwater. We offer underground and above-ground tanks from 2,000 to 65,000 litres. The Roterra, Robox and RoCube tanks are among the very best rotomoulded underground tanks on the market. But we do not focus solely on rainwater tanks; we can offer any product from the group's range.

02To go with our rainwater tanks, we offer a complete range of accessories for using rainwater for watering or…

To go with our rainwater tanks, we offer a complete range of accessories for using rainwater for watering or in the home.

For rainwater infiltration and the construction of permeable paved surfaces, we offer products from ASIO. Its infiltration and grass grids are among the best solutions we have seen on the market so far. ASIO is a long-established Czech company dealing with all aspects of water management.

For underground rainwater infiltration, we offer excellent infiltration tunnels and blocks, which stand out for their huge retention capacity, allowing the volume of underground soakaways to be reduced dramatically.

03Our rainwater management services

Our rainwater management services:

  • Consultation and advice
  • Preparation of design documentation
  • Obtaining the relevant building permit
  • Sale of technologies
  • Assembly and installation of the technology
  • Servicing and maintenance
  • Sale of spare parts

We have many years of experience installing rainwater tanks from various manufacturers, but we offer only goods that we would buy ourselves. The market is full of tanks of dubious quality at tempting prices, but that is not a path we want to take.

In our view, the self-supporting storage tanks from Roto are among the best and most durable rainwater tanks on the market. All tanks are made of first-class material, with no recycled content.

04Thanks to the material used and their ribbed design, these tanks are structurally very robust.

Thanks to the material used and their ribbed design, these tanks are structurally very robust. The tanks are self-supporting and are set on a bedding layer of sand and gravel. Because they are made by rotational moulding (“rotomoulding”), the tanks have no welds.

Rainwater can be used for watering the garden, washing the car, or for flushing toilets and doing the laundry. Plastic tanks stand out for their high-quality workmanship, self-supporting design and heavy ribbing. Their greatest advantages over concrete tanks are their low weight, easy handling and easy transport to the customer. All plastic tanks are self-supporting and are installed in a sand bed. Because plastic tanks (septic tanks, tanks, cesspits) are made by rotomoulding, which involves no gluing or welding, they are guaranteed to be completely leak-proof and watertight.
